summary.text: South Africa Champions won their match by 97 runs, finishing their innings at 55 for 1. Richard Levi was the top scorer in that innings with 32 off 19 balls, while Rayad Emrit took 1 for 20 as the best bowling against them. The usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches at Sharjah Cricket Stadium is 153.
